content.title: Publications & Research
content.text: Journals & Research Discover IEEE Xplore IEEE Xplore is our platform for access to scientific and technical content. It contains more than 7 million documents—from the over 200 periodicals published annually to conference proceedings, active IEEE standards, and more. Proceedings of the IEEE The leading journal since 1913, Proceedings of the IEEE covers all areas of electrical, electronics, and computer engineering. IEEE Access Our award-winning, multidisciplinary, open-access journal presents original research with a rapid review publication process. IEEE Potentials Focused on students and young professionals, IEEE Potentials explores career strategies, research, and technical developments. IEEE members save nearly 50% off single article purchases from IEEE Xplore, the largest library of electrical engineering, computer science, and electronics literature. IEEE Spectrum is our award-winning technology magazine and flagship publication, covering major trends and developments in technology, engineering, and science. Read the latest from IEEE Spectrum Publish & Access Research Data Discover IEEE Dataport IEEE DataPort is our research data platform designed to make research data accessible and help you find, share, and store datasets. The site features thousands of datasets, data competition hosting, data management tools, and more. Publications Where You Publish Matters IEEE is a trusted source for researchers in academia, industry, and government. Whether you’re looking to contribute to a journal or magazine, write a book, or present at a conference, publish with IEEE to get the global prestige your work deserves. Select option to display slide Podcasts Expert-Led Podcasts on the Latest Tech News and Trends From IEEE Spectrum’s "Fixing the Future" to IEEE Photonics Society’s "Illuminated," these podcasts connect you to the brightest minds in technology and keep you up-to-date on the latest breakthroughs. Membership Benefits You at Every Career Stage Join IEEE and get exclusive access to a global network of experts, world-class educational resources, and professional-development opportunities to advance your career. Explore More Learn how an IEEE membership helps you share your expertise, stay technically current, and make connections around the world.
